text:
erin_design: quick sync — noticed some friction in the latency dashboard UX after yesterday's perf patch. main things: range shortcuts feel duplicated with the sampling dropdown, the p95 sparkline is vertically misaligned when compact rows are on, and keyboard focus for the time range picker disappears when switching presets. any thoughts?

sam_frontend: I saw this too. the duplication is confusing for me — users pick a shortcut then the sampling UI still defaults to 'auto' and they assume it changed. maybe the shortcuts should update the sampling mode or at least surface a hint.

lucy_product: agree. goal is to make it obvious whether sampling changed. proposal: when you use a range shortcut, show a tiny banner: "Range selected — sampling still set to Auto. [Apply suggested sampling]" so it's explicit.

omar_research: nesting that microcopy into a transient banner sounds ok. from experiments, longer ranges should suggest coarser sampling (e.g., >24h -> sample=1m). we already calculate suggestions in backend — can surface them.

a11y_bot: Accessibility note: the transient banner must be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers. also, the compact row variant removes visible focus rings on the range presets; fix required.

sam_frontend: implementation detail: I can make the preset buttons set an ephemeral state that toggles the sampling dropdown open with the suggested value selected. that keeps behaviour discoverable without forcing a choice. does that address duplication?

erin_design: that sounds promising. another tiny item: p95 sparkline baseline — when density toggles shrink the container height, the sparkline's baseline moves down which makes p95 seem higher. can we lock sparkline scale to the p95 axis instead of container height?

omar_research: yea we should use a fixed y-domain per card based on the visible percentile band. otherwise visual comparisons across rows are misleading. we'll need to surface when we've flattened the y-scale (little icon?)

lucy_product: +1 on the icon. microcopy: change "Sampling: Auto" to "Sampling: Auto (suggested)" only when a suggestion is present, and clicking the suggestion should apply it and log an event.

a11y_bot: Microcopy tweak: use "Suggested sampling" as readable text for screen readers instead of parentheses. Also ensure the icon has an aria-label describing the scale lock state (e.g., "Y-scale locked to percentiles").

sam_frontend: TODOs for me: 1) make presets toggle sampling hint, 2) keep keyboard focus visible, 3) adjust sparkline scaling option and surface lock icon. estimate ~2 days.

erin_design: thanks. can we get a quick mock for the banner copy and the lock icon positions? want to review placement relative to per-route controls.

omar_research: i'll attach suggested thresholds for sampling rules in the doc after this thread. short summary: 1h->1s, 6h->5s, 24h->15s, >24h->60s (defaults, tweakable per-customer).

lucy_product: can we also add a keyboard shortcut hint: press 'r' to open range picker, then left/right to cycle presets — helpful for power users.

sam_frontend: added keyboard handler in branch, need design for focus states.

deploy_bot: deploy completed for branch: feature/timepicker-presets-hint (staging) :rocket:

erin_design: excellent. final ask: write a small UX acceptance checklist so PM/Design can sign off before shipping. I'll draft one and ping you all. :thumbsup:
